newsitem.title: USA: Typhoon weakening, still threatens Okinawa - WSC.
newsitem.headline: Typhoon weakening, still threatens Okinawa - WSC.

text.p: Typhoon Tina is weakening but is still a threat to Okinawa and southern Korea, private forecaster Weather Services Corp said on Wednesday.

Tina has top winds of 105 mph and is currently south of Japan, moving north-northwest. It is expected to slowly weaken, passing west of Okinawa in about 36 hours, bringing a chance of heavy rain with some flooding, as well as wind damage, WSC said.

By 72 hours time, Tina may threaten southern Korea with similar conditions, though there are some signs that the storm may turn more to the northwest. It will be a threat to shipping along its path as well.
